title: Chapter 1168 - 28: Crush It (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1168 - 28: Crush It (Seeking Subscription)

Chapter 1168: Chapter 28: Crush It (Seeking Subscription)

"The Eye of Myriad Laws, your creator, is a great Time Being."

The Jade Qilin Great Saint looked at the Eye of Myriad Laws, "Precisely for this reason, you cannot intervene in the entanglements and causality within the Chaos Void, nor can you directly stop us."

"You can call in favors to have other Supreme Saints stop us, but for how long?" The Jade Qilin Great Saint said with a smile.

Throughout the long years, the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion has helped many cultivators with great potential, a few of whom eventually became Supreme Saints.

But to expect these Supreme Saints to oppose us because of past assistance? The Jade Qilin Great Saint didn’t believe any Supreme Saint would do so.

Moreover, the Galaxy is now before us, and this physical body is doomed to annihilation. The Eye of Myriad Laws can at most prevent us from hunting down the true bodies of the Galaxy.

But only a Supreme Saint can stop me, and essentially, no Supreme Saint would do so.

The Eye of Myriad Laws remained silent.

Indeed it was so.

It is a special existence related to the Thirteenth Stage, holding a transcendent position in the Chaos Void, with no Supreme Saint daring to provoke it willingly.

Even the Xuan Emperor and the Moyu Tower Master, such Invincible Great Saints, would not dare to provoke it actively.

But ultimately, it is not a true Time Being and cannot bring much intimidation to Supreme Saints.

Supreme Saints hold it in respect at most, not in fear.

"Leave."

The Great Saint Hunxiao spoke, also having no intention of thoroughly offending the Eye of Myriad Laws, but Lin Yuan, this remnant of the Profound Xuanhuang, would certainly not be let go.

With Lin Yuan’s current strength, even if he cannot become a Supreme Saint in the future, he can easily pose a threat to their tribe when the two of them ascend to the Thirteenth Stage.

The two Supreme Saints have lived through numerous Cosmic Eras, with relatives and friends mostly deceased, but their tribe remains.

"Jade Qilin, Hunxiao, I will remember you."

The Eye of Myriad Laws directly dissipated on the spot.

At the same time.

The Star Tear Fragment World.

The Eye of Myriad Laws looked at Lin Yuan, "Galaxy, I’m helpless."

The Eye of Myriad Laws sighed, although before coming forward, it had predicted there was a high possibility that the two Supreme Saints would not heed its words.

But truly facing this scene, the Eye of Myriad Laws still felt somewhat helpless.

"However, with me here, those two can only erase your physical body in the Xuanhuang Universe. As for all your true bodies and avatars, that’s impossible."

The Eye of Myriad Laws said with a cold laugh.

"I know a few special Mysterious Places that can isolate causality and space-time. Besides me, no other beings, even Invincible Great Saints, can enter."

The Eye of Myriad Laws said: "Now prepare to bring along your tribe and friends, and I will transport you there."

While the Eye of Myriad Laws cannot directly intervene in the chaos and causality within the Chaos Void, it can indirectly influence it.

Like now, as the two Supreme Saints want to hunt down all Lin Yuan’s true bodies and avatars, the Eye of Myriad Laws simply sends Lin Yuan to a place the two Supreme Saints cannot enter.

Such that the two Supreme Saints are naturally helpless.

"Thank you."

Lin Yuan said with a slight tone of gratitude.

In fact, even without the Eye of Myriad Laws, Lin Yuan had means to protect his Primordial Spirit avatars.

The safest way is to place all the human civilization tribes into a micro world and then descend into other dimensional worlds via the Door of Myriad Worlds.

As long as the human civilization within the micro world doesn’t come out, they won’t notice the world’s changes. When Lin Yuan grows powerful enough to sweep through those two Supreme Saints, he can naturally bring the human civilization back.

However, this method involves different dimensions and perhaps risks exposing the Door of Myriad Worlds.

Unless absolutely necessary, Lin Yuan still prefers not to do so.

So far, Lin Yuan has never let a second person contact the Door of Myriad Worlds.

"No need to thank me."

"I’m also doing it for myself." The Door of Myriad Worlds said: "If you die at the hands of Jade Qilin and the others, wouldn’t my previous efforts to spread the path of Martial Path Evolution to you be in vain?"

The Door of Myriad Worlds helped Lin Yuan with its own plans as well.

One reason it held Lin Yuan in high regard, believing that as long as he continued growing smoothly, he would at least become an Invincible Great Saint.

The second is that the Door of Myriad Worlds had already made many ’investments’ in Lin Yuan, and naturally could not watch those two Supreme Saints make a move against him idly.

...

Xuanhuang Universe.

The Jade Qilin Great Saint and the Great Saint Hunxiao looked down at Lin Yuan.

"I’m curious about what you’ve gained in this Xuanhuang Universe. Did the Xuan Emperor leave anything concerning us..."

The Jade Qilin Great Saint said.

Now the entire Xuanhuang Universe is under the control of the two Supreme Saints, so there is no rush.

"No..."

Lin Yuan observed the two Supreme Saints while speaking.

Inside the Xuanhuang Mausoleum, there are many murals depicting the great events of the Xuan Emperor from obscurity to overlooking the entire Chaos Void.

But throughout, Lin Yuan never saw any record concerning the Jade Qilin Great Saint or the Great Saint Hunxiao.

If it weren’t for learning from the Tomb Spirit that the Xuan Emperor wiped out thirty-nine bodies of the two Supreme Saints before attempting to ascend to the Thirteenth Stage,

Lin Yuan wouldn’t even know the deeds of these two Supreme Saints.

"No?"

"The Xuan Emperor didn’t leave any information on us?"

The Jade Qilin Great Saint’s face turned ugly, and so did the Great Saint Hunxiao beside him.

The implication being that the Xuan Emperor never regarded them highly.

Upon realizing this, the aura of the two Supreme Saints began to ripple softly.

"It’s now."

Lin Yuan stepped forward.

The space-time around started to warp, specifically the Profound Xuanhuang’s three great Dao-Protecting Secret Skills—Space-Time Nine Steps.

Facing the two Supreme Saints, Lin Yuan had no intention of opposing them, but focused on escape instead.

"Space-Time Nine Steps?"

The Jade Qilin Great Saint shook his head slightly, "We’ve hunted enough of the disciples of the Profound Xuanhuang tribe and long developed means to suppress such escape secret skills."

Just as the words fell.

Lin Yuan noticed the surrounding space-time beginning to change, and his grasp over time and space rapidly waned.

"Failed on the first step?"

Lin Yuan thought to himself, likewise looking up at the two Supreme Saints.

"If that’s the case, then we’ll fight to the death."

Lin Yuan’s eyes slightly burned with fighting spirit, and the universe around him began to whirl crazily.

"Hmm?"

The Jade Qilin Great Saint showed a somewhat astonished expression, "Though not a Supreme Saint, on account of the personal domain, he can compel the Great Dao’s rules to retreat. Impressive."

"I increasingly want to kill you." The Great Saint Hunxiao’s tone gradually turned icy.

The more formidable Lin Yuan seemed, the stronger their desire to kill him grew.

Rumbling sounds.

In the next moment.

The Great Saint Hunxiao decisively acted, slapping at the universe around Lin Yuan.

...

Outside the Xuanhuang Universe.

In the twisted space-time, the Eye of Myriad Laws and several other special existences still had not left.

"Myriad Laws, what did you go in there for just now?"

The broken long blade glanced at the Eye of Myriad Laws.

The Eye of Myriad Laws had split a trace of power into the Xuanhuang Universe, and they naturally noticed it.

"Nothing in particular, just wanted to take someone away."

The Eye of Myriad Laws said.

"Take someone away?"

The broken long blade said, "Rejected by Hunxiao and the others?"

"Yes."

The Eye of Myriad Laws nodded.

"Humph!"

"Ants doomed to be trapped in a time loop, they can only show off their might now." The broken long blade shook its head.

As an existence similar to the Eye of Myriad Laws, it naturally stood in opposition to the Invincible Great Saint.

"Huh?"

Just then, the nearby ancient Altar Spirit was slightly surprised, "Is there a fight inside?"

At this moment, within the Xuanhuang Universe, vast space-time fluctuations faintly spread, like two prehistoric behemoths trembling in deep waters, causing the water surface to become unsteady.

...

Deep within the Xuanhuang Universe.

Lin Yuan exerted all his might to activate the cosmos outside his body, contending with Great Saint Hunxiao.

Combining the devouring of the Fierce Sun’s origin, along with mastering the second level of "Infinite Void," and the enhancement of refining the Dark Sky Heart.

Lin Yuan’s internal cosmos was already stronger than that of a normal Invincible Great Saint.

But the means of an Invincible Great Saint are by no means limited to the internal cosmos, let alone Great Saint Hunxiao, who is not just any Invincible Great Saint.

"Not a match."

Lin Yuan’s heart was heavy.

Although at this moment he barely contended with Great Saint Hunxiao, Lin Yuan knew it was only temporary. As time passed, he would inevitably be suppressed by this Invincible Great Saint.

"Detonate the external cosmos?"

Lin Yuan thought of this method, simultaneously glancing at the other Invincible Great Saint, Jade Qilin Great Saint.

No great hope in his heart.

With only Great Saint Hunxiao here, suddenly detonating the external cosmos might indeed create a chance to escape.

But beside Great Saint Hunxiao, there was also Jade Qilin Great Saint.

Under the pressure of two Invincible Great Saints, even detonating the external cosmos would hardly offer a chance to escape.

"Even if I lose this body, I’ll shatter all treasures and rare wonders in the end."

Lin Yuan made up his mind, he couldn’t destroy Great Saint-level weapons temporarily, but treasures and rare wonders? Those he could annihilate.

Suddenly.

At that moment.

Lin Yuan’s expression slightly changed.

Within his internal cosmos, the Xuanhuang Mausoleum was suspended, and the Tomb Spirit appeared.

"Can you withstand Hunxiao and Jade Qilin?" the Tomb Spirit asked.

"Probably not," Lin Yuan said truthfully. If not for Great Saint Hunxiao being unwilling to pay any price during his suppression, he would probably already be at a disadvantage.

"Alas..." The Tomb Spirit fell silent.

Once Lin Yuan couldn’t resist, everything in the Xuanhuang Universe would fall into the hands of Xuanhuang’s enemies.

Especially the three personal weapons of His Majesty, and that one bead...

"That bead... you should crush it." The Tomb Spirit said bitterly, as if it had made a certain decision.

"Crush that bead?" Lin Yuan furrowed his brow, "Wouldn’t that summon the treasure His Majesty obtained?"

Lin Yuan remembered the Tomb Spirit’s words: once that Xuanhuang bead was crushed, the treasure obtained by His Majesty from the dimensional rift would be acquired.

Even risking an early impact on the thirteenth stage to preserve that treasure.

"No matter, just crush it directly."

After saying this, the Tomb Spirit vanished from its place.

...

The outside world.

Lin Yuan’s expression was puzzled.

But since the Tomb Spirit said so.

He wouldn’t hesitate, and directly took out that Xuanhuang bead.

The bead was round, with a Xuanhuang color inside, surrounded by a faint aura of time.

Swish.

The Xuanhuang bead appeared in Lin Yuan’s hand.

"What is that?"

Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint also saw this scene, and upon seeing the Xuanhuang bead, they vaguely sensed something.

The next moment.

Lin Yuan held the Xuanhuang bead, applying gentle pressure.

Crack.

The bead was crushed with a crisp sound.

Time seemed to come to a halt.

The instant the Xuanhuang bead was crushed.

Threads of the power of time began to gather.

Space-time gradually manifested scene after scene, finally forming a loop, repeating endlessly like a cycle.

In the scenes.

Was an incomparably majestic heavenly court, with grand immortal palaces and lofty jade towers, in the highest divine hall, a man sat on the throne.

The man rested his head on his right hand, appearing to be in slumber.

But at the instant the Xuanhuang bead was crushed.

This man seemed to sense something, slowly opening his closed eyes.

Buzz.

The man vanished soundlessly from the throne.

Xuanhuang Universe.

Beside Lin Yuan.

At some unknown time, a robust and majestic man appeared.

The man was enveloped in golden light, perhaps the most emperorial of all the mighty Great Saints who had arisen across countless Cosmic Eras and myriad Cosmic Eras in the Chaos Void.

He stood quietly by Lin Yuan’s side, hands held behind his back, without looking at Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint, but instead cast a glance at Lin Yuan.

"You?"

Great Saint Hunxiao and Jade Qilin Great Saint trembled with terror, nearly turning to flee.
